name: @battuta/plugin-onscreen-keyboard
description: The on-screen keyboard: a touch panel that projects the union keymap — one button per action, sticky modifier latches, and a two-octave piano registered as a virtual MIDI input.
//: exports point at src/, NOT a built dist/: Vite and tsc both consume linked TypeScript, so a plugin has no build step and no prepare.
./keys is exported so the panel's key model can be read by a test outside this package without reaching into src/ by path; nothing in the app imports it.
dependencies: @battuta/api and react (a UI plugin renders into a host slot) and nothing else of the workspace. react-dom is NOT here: the host owns the React tree and the root.
